AssetPool.assign(address to,uint256 amount) onlyOwner, performs external calls to BPToken

Owned.transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner, calls removePool/addPool and rewrites owner
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a,uint b) returns a*b with an assert after the multiplication
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a,uint b) returns a-b after assert(b<=a)
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a,uint b) returns a+b with an assert after the addition
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a,uint b) returns a/b after assert(b>0)
